blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) warned that police would arrest or take legal action against persons who will hold demonstrations outside the designated freedom parks. This warning is in effect during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit that will happen from Nov. 15 to 17. Several groups previously announced that they would stage rallies before, during and after the regional high-stakes gathering, where foreign delegates and leaders, including United States Donald Trump, will attend. NCRPO Officer-in-Charge Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano on Friday said that he directed police commanders to strictly enforce security restrictions […]...
